reader.requirement: For a relative file in sequential access mode, REWRITE must succeed only when the last I-O statement executed for THAT file was a successful READ (otherwise status 43 and no update: no READ since OPEN, after another REWRITE, after a START, after an unsuccessful READ or a failed REWRITE), and then it replaces the record that READ accessed, whatever the RELATIVE KEY now holds; I-O on other files does not intervene.

edition-consulted.switches: passes the dialect level to the connector's Edition
FileSharingFacility off at 85 (no sharing arbitration); the 43 gate is the same code

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior over RelativeConnector.cs and FileConnector.cs: the 43 gate (PrevOpWasSuccessfulRead, set only by ReadSucceeded and dropped by every Status assignment) consults no edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f24_03 covers the successful replace of the record read; not the 43 refusal half (no READ, after REWRITE, after START, after an at-end READ, after a failed REWRITE)

reader.notes: Sequential access targets _lastSlot (the record the READ accessed), never the RELATIVE KEY. The same probe at --std 2023 prints the identical lines, consistent with no edition arm.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-136/g2b.cob at --std 85 (runs/g2b-001), SEQUENTIAL access, PIC 9(4) COMP key, two 01 records: READ 1, DELETE, REWRITE -> 'USE 43 / A-AFTER-DELETE 43'; READ (skips deleted 1) gets 2, REWRITE through the second 01 record-name -> 'B-REWRITE-REC2 00', record 2 = 'NEW022'; READ 3, failed START (23), REWRITE -> 'C-AFTER-BADSTART 43'; START NOT LESS 4 + READ 4, key moved to 1, REWRITE -> 'D-REWRITE 00' replaces record 4 (the record read, not the key's); CLOSE + reopen I-O, REWRITE -> 'E-AFTER-REOPEN 43'; READ, READ, REWRITE -> 00. Final file R2 NEW022, R3 NEW-03, R4 NEW-04, R5, R6, then EOF and 46 (VIII.1.3.4 5e3). The gate in RelativeConnector#Rewrite (sequential && !PrevOpWasSuccessfulRead -> 43, slot=_lastSlot) consults no edition. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR2  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.5c'.
